body:
Tested locally using the MRP I posted in https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/109531#issuecomment-3215884177, it works as expected. Code looks good to me.

> In the future we can look at introducing a full new pass that applies debanding after spatial scaling.

This likely has performance implications (especially on mobile GPUs). I'm not sure if it's worth the cost, considering the quality improvement is small in most scenarios.
